_comentario: Un dibujo por plano: es el primer fotograma que recibe H3. Se revisa y se rehace lo que no cierra ANTES de gastar un minuto de GPU.

Hard sodium-orange service lamps every few metres strobing past, deep black between them, thick concrete dust and diesel haze hanging in the air catching every beam. Wet rails throwing hard specular highlights. High ISO grain, heavy motion blur, handheld instability.

Leave the upper third relatively clear: an on-screen text overlay goes there in post.
